## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// A position-based rope: vertices ordered from one end to the other, chained
// by distance constraints. Thickness is the collision radius.
type Rope3D
    implements IValue
{
    Vertices: Array<ClothVertex>;
    DistanceConstraints: Array<ClothDistanceConstraint>;
    Thickness: Length;
}

// Solver parameters for a deformable (soft) body. VolumeCompliance and
// DeformationCompliance are inverse stiffnesses in meters per newton
// (0 = rigid response); Damping is the velocity decay rate in units of one
// per second; SolverIterations is the constraint iteration count per step.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soft-body_dynamics)
type SoftBodySettings
    implements IValue
{
    VolumeCompliance: Number;
    DeformationCompliance: Number;
    Damping: Number;
    SolverIterations: Integer;
}

//==
// # Fluids

// Smoothed-particle-hydrodynamics tuning. GasStiffness scales pressure
// response to compression, in pascal-cubic-meters per kilogram;
// SurfaceTension is in newtons per meter.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Smoothed-particle_hydrodynamics)
type SphParameters
    implements IValue
{
    RestDensity: Density;
    KernelRadius: Length;
    Viscosity: DynamicViscosity;
    GasStiffness: Number;
    SurfaceTension: Number;
}

// One fluid particle in a smoothed-particle-hydrodynamics simulation, with
// its current interpolated density and pressure.
type FluidParticle3D
    implements IValue
{
    Position: Point3D;
    Velocity: Vector3D;
    Density: Density;
    Pressure: Pressure;
    Mass: Mass;
}
```
